g.text: RAG Learning Assistant - SQLite Data Model
A future worker converts this request into a learning package.
All tables live in one library's metadata.sqlite3. vectors.faiss stores the
vectors separately and uses chunk IDs as the mapping back to SQLite metadata.
The schema currently declares no FOREIGN KEY constraints; services preserve
the dotted relationships and derived-data lifecycle.
JSON serialized into a TEXT column
Logical application relationship, not a SQLite foreign key
